notes.title: Soundtracks will be a paid item
notes.content:
It appears that I was mistaken and the soundtrack was released for free.

A short time later,
- Purchasers of "Fly Me To The Home!" will continue to be able to download the soundtrack for free.
- Only the soundtrack cannot be downloaded for free.
- Soundtracks can only be purchased.

Please understand the above.
